Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. New Zealand players make their way out in the middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto and Litton Das start with their blades for Bangladesh. Trent Boult to start with the ball. Here we go...
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, Bangladesh have a mountain to climb to stay alive in this tri-series. The way their batting has performed so far on this tour, it offers very little confidence but you never know in cricket. Stay tuned for the second innings...

Martin Guptill (34 off 27 balls) is in for a quick chat. He says that it was really nice to see the guys play and he is happy with the performance. Adds that it was nice for him to get the game time and they finished off in style. Further says that Neesham and Phillips finished off really well. Ends by saying that they have a good total and it should be enough.

It was yet another dismal show with the ball from Bangladesh. They looked listless, to say the least. Their catching did improve but the overall ground fielding was not up to the mark. Mohammad Saifuddin was the standout bowler and if we ignore his last over, he was quite impressive.

The batting of New Zealand revolved around the knock of Devon Conway who continued with his good form. Finn Allen was at his usual best in the Powerplay and then Martin Guptill, after his initial struggle, formed a fluent partnership for the second wicket. The real impetus to the innings though was provided by Glenn Phillips whose 24-ball 60 sent the Bangla bowlers on a leather hunt.

Incredible batting show from the Black Caps! They gathered 42 runs from the last three overs and that was mainly possible due to the batting blitz of Glenn Phillips. It's an imposing total on the board and Bangladesh will have to bat out of their skin to chase it down.
Fuller one, James Neesham tries to be cheeky this time with a paddle shot but fails to connect. They steal a bye. New Zealand end on 208 for 5.
Lands it on a length around leg, Bracewell gets down and across to play the paddle sweep but misses. It goes off his pads to the keeper and they cross for a leg bye.
Wide! Fuller and down the leg side, Bracewell tries to flick but fails to connect.
Michael Bracewell walks in.

OUT! Drags it on! End of an extraordinary knock! Ebadot Hossain's change in pace works this time. He dishes it out on a length around off, Glenn Phillips rocks back to power it across the line but is early into his shot. It takes the inner edge and cannons onto the stumps.
FOUR! Lovely placement! Ebadot serves it full and wide outside off, and Phillips reaches out and slams it over cover-point for a boundary.
Slower again, full and outside off, Phillips slices his drive over point. Picks up a couple and 200 comes up for New Zealand.
Full toss outside off, a loopy one, Phillips smacks it past extra cover and the long off fielder makes a tumbling stop to his left. The batters get two.
Ebadot Hossain to bowl the final over.
Fuller in length and outside off, James Neesham swishes and misses.  17 from the over.
Full again, wide outside off, Glenn steps back and has to reach out for it. Ends up playing it off the bottom edge and it goes to deep cover-point for a run.
FOUR! Fifty off just 19 balls, what a knock! Fuller in length around off, Phillips clears his front leg and bludgeons it over the bowler's head. No chance for long off.
SIX! That's a cracking shot! Fuller in length and outside off, Phillips latches onto the room and rifles it over covers. It goes with the wind and clears the fence.
SIX! Thrashed! Slower one, on a length and close to off, Phillips picks the variation in a trice and muscles it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
DOT BALL! Well bowled. Mohammad Saifuddin sees the batter backing to the leg side to create room and bowls a low full toss near the tram line. Glenn Phillips ends up allowing it through.
Another full toss, on middle, Neesham flicks it through mid-wicket and scampers back for the second run. 14 from the over!
A low full toss outside off, Glenn steps back and has to reach out for it. It goes off the bottom edge to extra cover and they cross.
Fullish and outside off, a touch on the slower side, Phillips smashes it down the ground off the toe end and collects two runs as the long on fielder mops it up.
SIX! Cracking shot! Too full in length and around leg, Phillips picks it off his pads and whips it all the way over mid-wicket for a maximum.
On a good length outside off, Neesham heaves it over mid-wicket but without much timing. Only a run.
Fuller and on middle, Neesham flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a couple.
Shoriful Islam comes back into the attack.
Very full and on off, it's stroked down the ground and the batters collect two runs. End of a fantastic over, two wickets and just 5 runs off it.
A low full toss on middle, Neesham brings his bat down in time and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Who will walk out now?

OUT! BOWLED! Back of a length, around middle and off at 124.9 kph, Mark Chapman camps back to again heave it over the leg side but misses. The ball goes on to clip one of the bails and Mohammad Saifuddin gets his second wicket. Bangladesh pulling things back a wee bit at the moment. The replay suggests that the ball might have stayed a bit low.
Shortish and on middle, Chapman heaves it to deep mid-wicket and takes a couple.
A cutter on middle and off, Mark helps it on the leg side and looks for a run. Mohammad Saifuddin runs to his left and makes a sliding stop. Glenn Phillips turns down the single seeing that effort.
Mark Chapman walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! A 125 kph short delivery, landing around middle, Conway stands back to pull across the line. He makes good connection but doesn't get the desired elevation to send it over the fielder in the deep. Najmul Hossain Shanto takes yet another safe catch in the deep and it's a vital breakthrough at this stage for Bangladesh.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Mohammad Saifuddin

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Saifuddin is back on.
Loopy and full, on middle, Phillips bunts it through wide mid off and returns for the second run. 18 from Shakib's last over. End of an expensive spell for him.
Shakib goes short and wide outside off, Glenn makes room and slaps it to deep cover. The fielder stops the ball near the fence and saves two runs.
SIX! Bang! Clean hit on this occasion. Flighted and full, landing around leg, Glenn Phillips uses the breeze to his advantage and strikes it ferociously over deep mid-wicket again.
SIX! Looked like a mishit but it sailed into the crowd. Floated and full, around middle, Glenn Phillips smokes it over mid-wicket and the wind takes it over the rope.
Advances down the track to loft it over covers but gets an inside edge. It dribbles to short fine leg and they cross.
Flatter and shorter on off, Phillips hammers it back past the bowler to long off. They cross.
Fuller one and on leg, Devon Conway looks to slog-sweep it but misses. A dot to end the over.
SIX! Touch fuller and on off, Devon Conway hammers it over long on for a maximum!
Fuller and on off, this is played towards long off for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Glenn Phillips eases it back towards the bowler.
Slightly shorter and on leg, Glenn Phillips pulls it to square leg for a brace.

Appeal for a run out! Touch fuller and on off, Glenn Phillips flicks it to mid-wicket and calls for two. The fielder makes a direct hit at the non-striker's end and Bangladesh appeal. The replay shows that the batter was well in. Excellent running between the wickets.
Mosaddek Hossain is back on. His first over went for 13 runs.
Length and on off, Glenn Phillips knocks it to long on for one.
Fuller and on off, Devon Conway guides it towards short third man and calls for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses. A direct hit would have been close.
On a length and just outside off, Devon Conway looks to cut it but gets an inside edge. The ball just misses the stumps and rolls towards fine leg. They collect two. Close!
Fuller and on middle, Glenn Phillips flicks it towards short mid-wicket. The fielder fails to stop it. The batters collect one and Glenn is off the mark.
Glenn Phillips walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ebadot Hossain bowls a full toss on off, Martin Guptill lofts it but the ball hits the upper part of his bat. It goes high up in the air towards long on. Najmul Hossain Shanto settles under it and pouches it easily with both hands. Not a wicket-taking delivery but Bangladesh won't mind this breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Ebadot Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Good length and on off, Martin Guptill rocks back and pulls it through deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Excellent shot!
Change in bowling. Ebadot Hossain is back into the attack.
On a length and on off, Martin Guptill cuts it towards point for one. 14 from the over!

SIX! Just over! On a length and on middle, Martin Guptill pulls it hard towards deep square leg. The fielder, Afif Hossain, makes an excellent one-handed effort at the fence but just gets his hand to it. The ball clears the fence for a biggie. Close!
Slightly shorter one, on middle. Devon Conway pulls it to mid-wicket for one again.
Good length and on off, Martin Guptill plays it towards point for one.
FOUR! Shorter one and on leg, Martin Guptill uses the pace of the ball and helps it through fine leg for a boundary!
On a length and down leg, Devon Conway looks to heave it but the ball hits his pads and rolls towards short fine leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Shoriful Islam is back on. 1 for 14 in his two overs so far.
Play and a miss. This one lands on off, Martin Guptill looks to sweep it but misses as the ball hits his pads. A dot to end the over.
Tosses it up, on off. Devon Conway sweeps it towards backward square leg for one again.
A single as this is played towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Serves it full and on off, Martin Guptill sweeps it through square leg for a boundary, his first of the innings.
Touch fuller, around off. Devon Conway flicks it towards square leg for one.
Tossed up, on off. Martin Guptill eases it to mid on for one.
Bowls it fuller, Devon Conway drives it towards deep extra cover for a brace. Fifty up for Devon Conway!
This one lands on off, Devon Conway flicks it but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Length and on off, Devon Conway pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. 50 partnership up between Devon Conway and Martin Guptill.
Shorter and wide outside off, Devon Conway lets it go. Wide called.
SIX! Up and over. Fuller and on off, Devon Conway stands firm and heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Good length again, on off. Devon Conway cuts it but finds the fielder at short third man.
On a length and on off, this is played towards mid-wicket for one.

Drinks! New Zealand are off to a flier. Finn Allen and Devon Conway started off really well. Finn Allen lost his wicket after a blazing 32 from 19 balls. Devon Conway took off well after his dismissal.
Fuller and on middle, knocked down to long on for a single. At the halfway mark, New Zealand are 87 for 1.
Shorter around off, Conway moves back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Flighted and around leg, Conway plays the reverse sweep but fails to beat Mohammad Saifuddin at backward point.
Wide! Skidding down the leg side, Guptill misses to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Another punch from the back foot, this time down to long on for a single.
Quicker one at the pads, Conway punches it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a couple.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Devon Conway steps back to punch but it takes the inner edge and rolls down through mid on. They cross. 13 from the over!
Fuller and on off, Devon works it off the inner half to deep mid-wicket for two.
Wide! Mosaddek Hossain fires a quicker one down the leg side, Conway tries to sweep but misses.
SIX! Boom! Mosaddek serves it short and around off, Conway rocks back and hammer-pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Jumps down the track to a full ball and knocks it to long on for a run.
Floated and full, around off, Guptill pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Flighted and on off, Guptill turns it through mid-wicket and the bowler himself runs after the ball. The batters take two.
Mosaddek Hossain comes into the attack.
Very full and around off, Guptill looks to tee off again but only scuffs his shot down to long on for a single.
Slower one, full and on off, Conway flicks and beats mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Fullish and down the leg side, Conway tries to flick but misses.
Mistimed! Full toss from Ebadot, on middle, Guptill tries to heave but it comes from the higher portion of his bat and goes to long on. It drops safely in the deep and they cross.
Angling in from around off, Guptill eases it to deep square leg and picks up a couple of runs.
Play and a miss! Ebadot Hossain delivers it on a length and close to off, Martin Guptill makes room and gives the charge for a big shot but it straightens to beat the bat.
On a length around leg, helped to square leg for one.
Fuller and on off, once again Guptill flicks across the line but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Walks across the stumps to a shortish ball and works it on the leg side, finds mid-wicket.
Taps a length ball down to backward point for a single.
FOUR! Sublime. Full in length and outside off, Devon Conway leans forward and crunches it through extra cover for a boundary.
Sliding down the leg side, Martin Guptill tickles it down to fine leg for one.
Full and angling across around off, it's driven down to long off for a single.
Soumya Sarkar comes into the attack.
Back of a length, around off and nipping in, Guptill fails to turn it around on the leg side and is hit on the thigh pad. At the end of the Powerplay, New Zealand are 54 for 1.
Slower one, on the pads, helped to short fine leg for a single.
Yorker on middle, jammed out to square leg for a run.
Chops a length ball down to cover and takes a single.
Around off, on a length, Devon defends it from the back foot.
FOUR! A length ball around off, Conway lofts it over mid off and fetches a boundary for himself.
Mohammad Saifuddin is on.
Good length and on leg, Martin Guptill flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off, Devon Conway eases it to point for one.
On a length and on off, Devon Conway looks to play at it but gets an inside edge. The ball goes towards the fielder at short fine leg. Dot.
On a length and on off, Martin Guptill pushes it to mid off and gets off the mark. They cross.
Martin Guptill walks in next, at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Bangladesh finally get the danger man. Shoriful Islam bowls it short and on leg, Finn Allen uses his feet and looks to loft it but doesn't get the power right. The ball goes up in the air towards mid-wicket where Yasir Ali takes a good catch diving to his left. Finn Allen departs for 32.
Commentary.Howout: c Yasir Ali b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Amazing timing again. This one lands on a length and on off, Finn Allen uses his feet and lofts it towards long on for a boundary.
Play and a miss. This one lands outside off, Devon Conway looks to play the reverse sweep but misses.
Shoriful Islam returns to bowl his second over.
Quicker one this time, Devon Conway whips it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and on leg, Devon Conway goes on his back foot and knocks it through long on for a boundary!
Tosses it up on middle, this is played towards mid on for one more.
Another fuller one, Devon Conway flicks it towards the left of mid on for one.
Tossed up, on middle. Finn Allen flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller again, on middle. Finn Allen flicks it past square leg. The fielder does well diving to his right and stops it just before the fence. They collect three runs. 15 from the over!
Shakib Al Hasan brings himself into the attack. Meanwhile, Finn Allen has changed his bat.
SIX! This is very well connected. Fuller one on off, Finn Allen launches it over backward square leg for another biggie.
On a length and on middle, Finn Allen mistimes his drive back towards the bowler.
SIX! Up and over. Shorter one on leg, Finn Allen moves forward and pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum.
This one lands outside off, Finn Allen looks to play at it but gets a bottom edge. The ball goes towards the keeper.
Shorter one this time, On off. Finn Allen looks to pull it but misses.
Ebadot Hossain to bowl now.
Another one on leg, Devon Conway looks to flick it but misses.
FOUR! On a length and on leg, Devon Conway rocks back and flicks it through to fine leg for a boundary!

On a length and on leg, Finn Allen looks to pull it but misses. It goes off his thigh towards short fine leg. The keeper thought it was off the bat and runs towards it and takes a diving catch. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. A leg bye taken.
Fuller once again, on leg. This is defended towards the leg side.
FOUR! Excellent timing. Touch fuller and outside off, Finn Allen stands firm and caresses it over mid off for a one-bounce boundary!
Goes length and on leg, Finn Allen defends it towards the leg side.
Shoriful Islam to bowl from the other end.
On a length and on off, Devon Conway plays it straight towards Shakib Al Hasan at mid off. A dot to end the over.
Fuller one, down leg. Finn Allen flicks it to square leg for one.
FOUR! First boundary of the game. This one lands on a length and outside off, Finn Allen dances down the track and smashes it over mid off for a boundary.
Goes fuller, on leg. Finn Allen tries to flick it but gets it on his pads instead. A stifled appeal for an lbw turned down.
On a length and down the middle, Finn Allen knocks it straight. The bowler stops it well diving to his right. Dot.
Slip moves out to mid-wicket and the cover fielder goes in the deep. Bangladesh are on the defense already.
Slightly shorter this time, Finn Allen looks to pull it but gets a bottom edge towards fine leg. They collect two.
Starts with a length ball outside leg, Finn Allen looks to flick it but misses. Wide called.

Time to get underway. Nice sunshine at the moment at the Hagley Oval. Out come the Bangladesh players and they are followed by the opening pair of New Zealand - Finn Allen and Devon Conway.​ Mohammad Saifuddin to deliver the first over. One slip in place. Here we go...
Pitch report - The pitch has a nice even covering of grass but it's not green in colour. There could be some movement in the air and off the pitch in the first 6 overs.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Najmul Hossain Shanto, Soumya Sarkar (In for Mehidy Hasan), Litton Das, Shakib Al Hasan (C), Afif Hossain, Mosaddek Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Yasir Ali, Mohammad Saifuddin (In for Taskin Ahmed), Ebadot Hossain (In for Hasan Mahmud), Shoriful Islam.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Devon Conway (WK), Finn Allen, Martin Guptill (In for Kane Williamson), Glenn Phillips, Mark Chapman, James Neesham, Michael Bracewell, Ish Sodhi, Adam Milne (In for Mitchell Santner), Tim Southee (C), Trent Boult (In for Blair Tickner).
TOSS - Bangladesh have won the toss and will BOWL first.
